name: query_telemetry_window
description: Queries historical telemetry snapshots within a custom time window. The agent can choose its own window based on user queries (e.g. 'what happened at 3 am?'). Returns summaries of flows, active counts, and port metrics.

end_time.description: End of the window (defaults to start_time + 1 hour or current time).

minutes_ago.description: Optional relative lookback in minutes from the present time (e.g. 15 for the last 15 minutes).

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return (default: 10).
